## Module: loading

### confirm_shipment

Irreversible complete-Load Goods Issue: atomic stock, serials, Orders, Load and Dispatch.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / loading |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `confirm_shipment` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `outbound_load`: send `expected_load_version` for row `load_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_load_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ConfirmShipment) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_load_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.load_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": ConfirmShipmentResult }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.already_committed` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.load` | object (OutboundLoad) | yes |  |
| `data.load.active_stop_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.load.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.load.completed_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.load.dispatch_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.load.door_location_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.load.frozen_plan_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.load.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.load.last_actual_sequence` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.load.load_plan_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.load.opened_at` | string | yes |  |
| `data.load.opened_by` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.load.require_staged` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.load.sequence_policy` | one of: ReverseStop \| ForwardStop \| StopGroup \| Explicit \| Unrestricted | yes |  |
| `data.load.shipped_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.load.started_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.load.status` | one of: Open \| Loading \| Loaded \| Shipped \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.load.transport_confirmed` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.load.transport_external_ref` | string | yes |  |
| `data.load.transport_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.load.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.orders` | array of object (ShipShipmentOrderResult) | yes |  |
| `data.orders[].already_committed` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.orders[].close_summary` | any | yes |  |
| `data.orders[].goods_issue_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.orders[].journal_ids` | array of integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.orders[].new_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.orders[].order_closed` | boolean | no |  |
| `data.orders[].order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.orders[].remaining_quantities` | array of array of integer (int64) | no |  |
| `data.orders[].serial_ids` | array of integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.orders[].shipped_quantities` | array of array of integer (int64) | yes |  |

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "data": {
      "already_committed": false,
      "load": {
        "code": "<code>",

        "frozen_plan_version": 1,
        "id": 1,
        "last_actual_sequence": 1,
        "load_plan_id": 1,

        "require_staged": false,
        "sequence_policy": "ReverseStop",
        "status": "Open",
        "transport_confirmed": false,
        "transport_external_ref": "<transport_external_ref>",
        "transport_unit_id": 1,
        "version": 1
      },
      "orders": [
        {
          "already_committed": false,
          "close_summary": {},
          "goods_issue_id": 1,
          "journal_ids": [
            1
          ],
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "confirm_shipment",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_load_version": 1,
      "load_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### load_complete

Complete all required units only after rechecking their immutable content.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / loading |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `load_complete` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `outbound_load`: send `expected_load_version` for row `load_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_load_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CompleteLoad) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_load_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.load_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": OutboundLoad }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.active_stop_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.completed_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.dispatch_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.door_location_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.frozen_plan_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.last_actual_sequence` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.load_plan_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.opened_at` | string | yes |  |
| `data.opened_by` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.require_staged` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.sequence_policy` | one of: ReverseStop \| ForwardStop \| StopGroup \| Explicit \| Unrestricted | yes |  |
| `data.shipped_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.started_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.status` | one of: Open \| Loading \| Loaded \| Shipped \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.transport_confirmed` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.transport_external_ref` | string | yes |  |
| `data.transport_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "load_complete",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_load_version": 1,
      "load_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### load_open

Open Load from a reviewed Frozen plan and registered transport.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / loading |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `load_open` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `load_plan`: send `expected_plan_version` for row `load_plan_id` |
| Version check | entity `transport_unit`: send `expected_transport_version` for row `transport_unit_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_plan_version`, `expected_transport_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (OpenLoad) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_plan_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_transport_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.load_plan_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.transport_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": OutboundLoad }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.active_stop_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.completed_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.dispatch_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.door_location_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.frozen_plan_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.last_actual_sequence` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.load_plan_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.opened_at` | string | yes |  |
| `data.opened_by` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.require_staged` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.sequence_policy` | one of: ReverseStop \| ForwardStop \| StopGroup \| Explicit \| Unrestricted | yes |  |
| `data.shipped_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.started_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.status` | one of: Open \| Loading \| Loaded \| Shipped \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.transport_confirmed` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.transport_external_ref` | string | yes |  |
| `data.transport_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "load_open",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_plan_version": 1,
      "expected_transport_version": 1,
      "load_plan_id": 1,
      "transport_unit_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

```bash
      }
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

}'
```

| `data.kind` | one of: Truck \| Trailer \| Container \| SwapBody \| CourierCage | yes |  |
| `data.plate` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

### transport_unit_list

List transport resources with ordinary list filtering and pagination; no loading claims.

| | |
|---|---|

**Notes**

| `filters[].carrier_id` | integer filter | no | Filter on `carrier_id`. |
| `filters[].plate` | string filter | no | Filter on `plate`. |
| `filters[].active` | boolean filter | no | Filter on `active`. |
| `list_options` | object | no | Pagination/sorting |
| `list_options.limit` | integer | no |  |
| `list_options.offset` | integer | no |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": [TransportUnit] }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data[].active` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data[].carrier_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data[].external_ref` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].kind` | one of: Truck \| Trailer \| Container \| SwapBody \| CourierCage | yes |  |
| `data[].plate` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 500 | SERVICE_ERROR | `list_options.limit` is above 5000 (the code maps this refusal to the general error). |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "transport_unit_list",
  "params": {
    "filters": [
      {
        "id": 1
      }
    ],
    "list_options": {
      "limit": 10,
      "offset": 0
    }
  }
}'
```

### transport_unit_register

Register a transport resource, never a warehouse container.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / loading |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `transport_unit_register` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (RegisterTransportUnit) | yes |  |
| `data.carrier_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.external_ref` | string | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.kind` | one of: Truck \| Trailer \| Container \| SwapBody \| CourierCage | yes |  |
| `data.plate` | string or null | no |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": TransportUnit }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.active` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.carrier_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.external_ref` | string | yes |  |
| `data.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.kind` | one of: Truck \| Trailer \| Container \| SwapBody \| CourierCage | yes |  |
| `data.plate` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "active": false,
      "external_ref": "<external_ref>",
      "id": 1,
      "kind": "Truck",
      "version": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "transport_unit_register",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "external_ref": "<external_ref>",
      "kind": "Truck"
    }
  }
}'
```

## Module: load_plan

### load_plan_add_unit

Add a current root from the seen unit and transport cards to an ExplicitUnit plan.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / load_plan |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `load_plan_add_unit` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `load_plan`: send `expected_plan_version` for row `load_plan_id` |
| Version check | entity `outbound_flow_unit`: send `expected_unit_version` for row `outbound_flow_unit_id` |
| Version check | entity `outbound_unit_assignment`: send `expected_assignment_version` for row `outbound_flow_unit_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_plan_version`, `expected_unit_version`, `expected_assignment_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (AddLoadPlanUnit) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_assignment_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_plan_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_unit_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.load_plan_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.outbound_flow_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": LoadPlanMutationResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.plan` | object (LoadPlan) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.add_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.plan.add_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.plan.dispatch_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.frozen_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.plan.generated_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.plan.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.mod_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.plan.mod_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.mode` | one of: StopBased \| ExplicitUnit | yes |  |
| `data.plan.sequence_policy` | one of: ReverseStop \| ForwardStop \| StopGroup \| Explicit \| Unrestricted | yes |  |
| `data.plan.status` | one of: Draft \| Planned \| Frozen \| Completed | yes |  |
| `data.plan.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "plan": {
        "add_when": "<add_when>",
        "add_who": 1,
        "code": "<code>",
        "dispatch_id": 1,
        "id": 1,
        "mod_when": "<mod_when>",
        "mod_who": 1,
        "mode": "StopBased",
        "sequence_policy": "ReverseStop",
        "status": "Draft",
        "version": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "load_plan_add_unit",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_assignment_version": 1,
      "expected_plan_version": 1,
      "expected_unit_version": 1,
      "load_plan_id": 1,
      "outbound_flow_unit_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `load_plan`: send `expected_plan_version` for row `load_plan_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_plan_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (FreezeLoadPlan) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_plan_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.load_plan_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.units` | array of object (LoadPlanUnitExpectation) | yes |  |
| `data.units[].expected_assignment_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.units[].expected_unit_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.units[].outbound_flow_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": LoadPlanMutationResult }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.plan` | object (LoadPlan) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.add_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.plan.add_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.plan.dispatch_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.frozen_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.plan.generated_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.plan.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.mod_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.plan.mod_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.plan.mode` | one of: StopBased \| ExplicitUnit | yes |  |
| `data.plan.sequence_policy` | one of: ReverseStop \| ForwardStop \| StopGroup \| Explicit \| Unrestricted | yes |  |
| `data.plan.status` | one of: Draft \| Planned \| Frozen \| Completed | yes |  |
| `data.plan.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "data": {
      "plan": {
        "add_when": "<add_when>",
        "add_who": 1,
        "code": "<code>",
        "dispatch_id": 1,
        "id": 1,
        "mod_when": "<mod_when>",
        "mod_who": 1,
        "mode": "StopBased",
        "sequence_policy": "ReverseStop",
        "status": "Draft",
        "version": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_plan_version": 1,
      "load_plan_id": 1,
      "units": [
        {
          "expected_assignment_version": 1,
          "expected_unit_version": 1,
          "outbound_flow_unit_id": 1
        }
      ]
```
```bash
    }
  }
}'
```

## Module: allocation_policy

### allocation_pipeline_view

Read one allocation policy's step pipeline — its readback, its skip reasons and its closed steps — optionally narrated over the drafts the editor is holding.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / allocation_policy |
| Category | query |
| Operation | read (read_model) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `allocation_pipeline_view` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR, VIEWER |
| Idempotency key | not stated in the catalog |

**Notes**

- This method only reads. It changes nothing and needs no idempotency key.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `drafts` | array of object (StepDraft) or null | no |  |
| `drafts[].fields` | any | yes | Raw JSON, for the same reason the save's `fields` is: serde folds `{"putawayzone": null}` and `{}` into the same `None`, and "clear this narrowing" must not read as "leave it alone" in a preview any more than it may in a write. |
| `drafts[].step_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": PipelineView }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.lifecycle` | one of: Draft \| Published \| Retired | yes | Drives editor affordances: only `Draft` accepts header/step writes. |
| `data.next_rule_num` | string | yes | What the system will call the next step the operator adds. |
| `data.policy_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.policy_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.policy_version` | integer (int32) | yes | The policy's own optimistic lock — what a reorder must echo back. |
| `data.steps` | array of object (PipelineStep) | yes | Every step of the policy, switched-off ones included, in execution order (`sequence`, never `rule_num` — that is `varchar(5)` and sorts '10' before '2'). |
| `data.steps[].active` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.steps[].clauses` | array of object (Clause) | yes | The running sentence, in the pieces the card's four bands need. |
| `data.steps[].closed_by` | string or null | no | The `rule_num` of the earlier step that leaves this one nothing to reserve, when there is one. |
| `data.steps[].fields` | object (StepFields) | yes | The thirteen card fields, under their own column names. |
| `data.steps[].id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.steps[].never_reserves` | array of object (Clause) | yes | What this step can never reserve even though the engine loads and runs it — a measured unit against a rule written for counted ones. |
| `data.steps[].rule_num` | string | yes |  |
| `data.steps[].sequence` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.steps[].skip_reasons` | array of object (Clause) | yes | Why the engine would refuse this step when it LOADS the policy. |
| `data.steps[].switched_off` | string or null | no | The sentence for a step the engine never loads because somebody switched it off, in the core's own words (`allocation_step_switched_off`) — `None` for a step that is on. |
| `data.steps[].version` | integer (int32) | yes | This step's own optimistic lock — per step, never per policy, because two supervisors editing two different steps must not collide. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "data": {
      "lifecycle": "Draft",
      "next_rule_num": "<next_rule_num>",
      "policy_code": "<policy_code>",
      "policy_id": 1,
      "policy_version": 1,
      "steps": [
        {
          "active": false,
          "clauses": [
            {
              "runs": null,
              "text": null,
              "topic": null
            }
          ],
          "fields": {
            "allocation_type": "Firm",
            "lpn_quantity_rule": "Any",
            "one_pick_per_uom_location": false,
            "sort_1": "LotRotation",
            "uom_code": "<uom_code>"
          },
          "id": 1,
          "never_reserves": [
            {
              "runs": null,
              "text": null,
              "topic": null
            }
          ],
          "rule_num": "<rule_num>",
          "sequence": 1,
          "skip_reasons": [
            {
              "runs": null,
              "text": null,
              "topic": null
            }
          ],
          "version": 1
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | ENTITY_NOT_FOUND | No row has this id. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "allocation_pipeline_view",
  "params": {
    "id": 1
  }
}'
```

Clone any allocation policy and all its steps into a new draft.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / allocation_policy |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CloneAllocationPolicy) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.new_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.source_policy_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": CloneAllocationPolicyResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.policy_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "policy_id": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,

  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "new_code": "<new_code>",
      "source_policy_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

**Notes**

| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CreateWave) | yes |  |
| `data.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": WaveMutationResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.wave` | object (Wave) | yes |  |
| `data.wave.add_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.wave.add_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.wave.cancelled_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.wave.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.wave.completed_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.wave.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.wave.mod_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.wave.mod_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.wave.planned_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.wave.policy_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.wave.policy_run_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.wave.release_generation` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.wave.release_requested_by` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.wave.released_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.wave.station_location` | string or null | no | The distribution station (a `Sort` location) the wave is released onto; `None` = no station (wms-app 095, R-4). |
| `data.wave.status` | one of: Draft \| Planned \| Released \| InProgress \| Completed \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.wave.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "wave": {
        "add_when": "<add_when>",
        "add_who": 1,
        "code": "<code>",
        "id": 1,
        "mod_when": "<mod_when>",
        "mod_who": 1,
        "release_generation": 1,
        "status": "Draft",
        "version": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "wave_create",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "code": "<code>"
    }
  }
}'
```

### wave_policy_build

Build bounded Draft Waves from a versioned Wave policy.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / wave |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `wave_policy_build` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `wave_policy`: send `expected_policy_version` for row `policy_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_policy_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |

| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (BuildWavePolicy) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_policy_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.policy_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": WavePolicyBuildResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| `data.exclusions` | array of object (WavePolicyExclusion) | yes |  |
| `data.exclusions[].order` | object (WavePolicyCandidate) | yes | One currently eligible Order and the capacity fact W2a can prove before allocation: its active document-line count. |
| `data.exclusions[].reason` | string | yes |  |
| `data.policy` | object (WavePolicy) | yes |  |

| `data.policy.eligible_statuses` | array of string | yes |  |
| `data.policy.group_by_carrier` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.group_by_owner` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.group_by_requested_ship_date` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.policy.include_undated` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.is_active` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.last_scheduled_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.max_lines` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.max_orders` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.policy.max_waves_per_run` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.policy.mod_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.policy.mod_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.policy.next_run_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.owner_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.priority_from` | integer (int16) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.priority_to` | integer (int16) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.requested_ship_days_ahead` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.schedule_interval_minutes` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.schedule_starts_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.station_location` | string or null | no | The distribution station every wave this policy builds names (R-4); `None` = no station. |
| `data.policy.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.run` | object (WavePolicyRun) | yes |  |
| `data.run.add_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.run.candidate_count` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.run.completed_at` | string or null | no |  |

### wave_policy_create

**Notes**

### wave_policy_save

Save a versioned Wave policy.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / wave |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `wave_policy_save` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `wave_policy`: send `expected_policy_version` for row `policy_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_policy_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (SaveWavePolicy) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_policy_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.policy` | object (WavePolicyForWrite) | yes | The complete user-owned part of a policy. |
| `data.policy.auto_release` | boolean | no |  |
| `data.policy.carrier_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.policy.description` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.eligible_statuses` | array of string | yes |  |
| `data.policy.group_by_carrier` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.group_by_owner` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.group_by_requested_ship_date` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.include_undated` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.is_active` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.policy.max_lines` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.max_orders` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.policy.max_waves_per_run` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.policy.owner_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.priority_from` | integer (int16) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.priority_to` | integer (int16) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.requested_ship_days_ahead` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.schedule_interval_minutes` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.schedule_starts_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.station_location` | string or null | no | The distribution station the policy's waves are released onto (R-4). |

| `data.policy.requested_ship_days_ahead` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.schedule_interval_minutes` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.policy.schedule_starts_at` | string or null | no |  |

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",

      "idempotency_replayed": false

      "policy": {
        "add_when": "<add_when>",
        "add_who": 1,
        "auto_release": false,
        "code": "<code>",
        "eligible_statuses": [
          "<eligible_statuses>"
        ],

        "id": 1,
        "include_undated": false,
        "is_active": false,
        "max_orders": 1,
        "max_waves_per_run": 1,
        "mod_when": "<mod_when>",
        "mod_who": 1,
        "version": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |

| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{

        ],
        "group_by_carrier": false,
        "group_by_owner": false,
        "group_by_requested_ship_date": false,
        "include_undated": false,
        "is_active": false,
        "max_orders": 1,
        "max_waves_per_run": 1
      },
      "policy_id": 1
```
```bash
    }
  }
}'
```

### wave_set_station

| `data.station_location` | string or null | no | A `Sort` location with positions; `None` clears the station. |

### dispatch_plan

Freeze a manually prepared Dispatch as Planned.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / dispatch |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `dispatch_plan` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `dispatch`: send `expected_dispatch_version` for row `dispatch_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_dispatch_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (PlanDispatch) | yes |  |
| `data.dispatch_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_dispatch_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": DispatchMutationResult }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.dispatch` | object (Dispatch) | yes |  |
| `data.dispatch.add_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.dispatch.add_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.dispatch.cancelled_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.dispatch.carrier_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.dispatch.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.dispatch.door_location_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.dispatch.external_ref` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.dispatch.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.dispatch.mod_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.dispatch.mod_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.dispatch.planned_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.dispatch.planned_departure_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.dispatch.status` | one of: Draft \| Planned \| Shipped \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.dispatch.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "data": {
      "dispatch": {
        "add_when": "<add_when>",
        "add_who": 1,
        "code": "<code>",
        "id": 1,
        "mod_when": "<mod_when>",
        "mod_who": 1,
        "status": "Draft",
        "version": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "dispatch_plan",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "dispatch_id": 1,
      "expected_dispatch_version": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### dispatch_stop_list

Filter and page ordered Dispatch stops, without changing their sequence.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / dispatch |
| Category | query (read operation; not declared in the catalog) |
| Operation | read (read_model) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `dispatch_stop_list` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |

**Notes**

- This method only reads. It changes nothing and needs no idempotency key.
- In `filters`, a plain value means equals. An object such as `{"$gt": 5}` uses an operator. See 03-request-and-response-format.md.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filters` | array of object | no | Filter criteria |
| `filters[].id` | integer filter | no | Filter on `id`. |
| `filters[].dispatch_id` | integer filter | no | Filter on `dispatch_id`. |
| `filters[].sequence` | integer filter | no | Filter on `sequence`. |
| `filters[].destination_ref` | string filter | no | Filter on `destination_ref`. |
| `list_options` | object | no | Pagination/sorting |
| `list_options.limit` | integer | no |  |
| `list_options.offset` | integer | no |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": [DispatchStop] }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data[].add_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].add_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].destination_ref` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].dispatch_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].mod_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].mod_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].planned_arrival_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].planned_departure_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].sequence` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data[].stop_type` | string | yes |  |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 500 | SERVICE_ERROR | `list_options.limit` is above 5000 (the code maps this refusal to the general error). |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "dispatch_stop_list",
  "params": {
    "filters": [
      {
        "id": 1
      }
    ],
    "list_options": {
      "limit": 10,
      "offset": 0
    }
  }
}'
```

### outbound_unit_assignment_get

- This method only reads. It changes nothing and needs no idempotency key.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `data` | object (UnitIdInput) | yes |  |
| `data.outbound_flow_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": UnitAssignmentDetails }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `data.history[].after_assignment` | any | yes |  |
| `data.history[].assignment_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.history[].before_assignment` | any | no |  |
| `data.history[].changed_at` | string | yes |  |
| `data.history[].changed_by` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.history[].id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.history[].outbound_flow_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.history[].reason` | string | yes |  |
| `data.presentation` | object (UnitAssignmentPresentation) | no | Readable facts from the SAME snapshot as assignment/intent, never a second container/Dispatch read that could describe a different plan. |
| `data.presentation.container_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.presentation.current_dispatch_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.presentation.current_location` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.presentation.current_stop_sequence` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.presentation.order_number` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.presentation.target_dispatch_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.presentation.target_dispatch_status` | one of: Draft \| Planned \| Shipped \| Cancelled or null | no |  |
| `data.presentation.target_stop_sequence` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.staged_remainder` | object (StagedRemainderReview) or null | no |  |
| `data.staged_remainder.execution_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.staged_remainder.previous_dispatch_status` | one of: Draft \| Planned \| Shipped \| Cancelled or null | no |  |
| `data.staged_remainder.stage_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.staged_remainder.stage_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.state` | object (UnitAssignmentState) | yes |  |
| `data.state.assignment` | object (OutboundUnitAssignment) or null | no |  |
| `data.state.assignment_version` | integer (int32) | yes | Zero denotes absence, and is the only valid Assign version. |
| `data.state.is_current_root` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.state.nested_units` | boolean | yes | Composite replan belongs to the future Consolidation door. |
| `data.state.order_intent` | object (DispatchOrder) or null | no | Immutable membership id: echo it to refuse a stale transport plan. |
| `data.state.packing_open` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.state.stage_committed` | boolean | yes | Authoritative physical Stage commitment, independent of Router markers. |
| `data.state.unit` | object (OutboundFlowUnit) | yes |  |

### outbound_unit_reassign

Explicitly align an assigned physical root with its confirmed current Order plan; no stock movement.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / outbound_unit_assignment |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `outbound_unit_reassign` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `outbound_unit_assignment`: send `expected_assignment_version` for row `outbound_flow_unit_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_assignment_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ReassignOutboundUnit) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_assignment_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_order_intent_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.outbound_flow_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.reason` | string | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": UnitAssignmentResult }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.assignment` | object (OutboundUnitAssignment) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.add_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.add_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.dispatch_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.mod_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.mod_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.outbound_flow_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.preferred_stage_location_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | A planning hint, not the unit's physical location. |
| `data.assignment.source_order_intent_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.status` | one of: Assigned | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.stop_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "data": {
      "assignment": {
        "add_when": "<add_when>",
        "add_who": 1,
        "dispatch_id": 1,
        "id": 1,
        "mod_when": "<mod_when>",
        "mod_who": 1,
        "outbound_flow_unit_id": 1,
        "source_order_intent_id": 1,
        "status": "Assigned",
        "stop_id": 1,
        "version": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "outbound_unit_reassign",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_assignment_version": 1,
      "expected_order_intent_id": 1,
      "outbound_flow_unit_id": 1,
      "reason": "<reason>"
    }
  }
}'
```

| Operation | read (read_model) |

| `data.cancelled_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.carrier_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.close_summary` | any | no |  |
| `data.closed_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.external_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.notes` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.order_date` | string | yes |  |
| `data.order_number` | string | yes |  |
| `data.order_type_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.owner_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

| `data.released_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.requested_ship_date` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.ship_to_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.ship_to_snapshot` | any | no | The ship-to address as frozen at release. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": [ShipmentFulfilmentLine] }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data[].id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].line_no` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data[].order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].owner_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].qty_cancelled` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data[].qty_ordered` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data[].qty_picked` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data[].qty_remaining` | number (double) | yes | Effective demand not yet shipped, including unreserved demand. |
| `data[].qty_shipped` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data[].sku_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].status` | string | yes |  |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 500 | SERVICE_ERROR | `list_options.limit` is above 5000 (the code maps this refusal to the general error). |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "shipment_order_fulfilment_list",
  "params": {
    "filters": [
      {
        "id": 1
      }
    ],
    "list_options": {
      "limit": 10,
      "offset": 0
    }
  }
}'
```

## Module: shipment_order_commands

### pick_detail_delete

Delete one reservation (pick) from an order, releasing its qty.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / shipment_order_commands |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_detail_delete` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (DeletePickDetail) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.pick_detail_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": DeletePickDetailResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.line_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.line_status` | one of: NotAllocated \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The affected LINE's stored status after the same derivation — the shape `CancelLineQtyResult::line_status` already reports for the other line-touching command family. |
| `data.new_version` | integer (int32) | yes | Echo of the header version that was already there — this command never writes the header row (releases touch LINES and `pick_detail`), same contract as `CancelOrderAllocationResult::new_version`. |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.order_status` | one of: New \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The header status AS DERIVED after the release, in this command's own transaction — same contract as `CancelOrderAllocationResult::status` (`cancel_allocation.rs`): the screen patches its copy of the order from this (spec §6.3) instead of keeping whatever it… |
| `data.released_qty` | number (double) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "line_id": 1,
      "line_status": "NotAllocated",
      "new_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1,
      "order_status": "New",
      "released_qty": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_detail_delete",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "order_id": 1,
      "pick_detail_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### shipment_order_allocate

Allocate a released order's open lines against available stock.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / shipment_order_commands |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `shipment_order_allocate` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `shipment_order`: send `expected_order_version` for row `order_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_order_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (AllocateShipmentOrder) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_order_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": AllocateShipmentOrderResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.allocated` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.blocked_by_dropped_step` | number (double) | yes | Sum, across every line, of `crate::allocation::LineAllocationPlan::blocked_by_dropped_step` — base units `short` includes that were never searched for at all, because the only step of some line's policy naming that UOM rung failed to parse (round-2 review fin… |
| `data.cartonization` | object (WrittenPlan) or null | no | What cartonization computed: the plan number and how many boxes, placements and unplaced items it holds. |
| `data.cartonization.cartons` | integer (uint) | yes |  |
| `data.cartonization.master_data_divergences` | array of string | no | What stands was taken as written; where today's master data says otherwise, it is named here for master-data review (an executed unit whose size, weight or rotation rule changed). |
| `data.cartonization.placements` | integer (uint) | yes |  |
| `data.cartonization.plan_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.cartonization.unplaced` | integer (uint) | yes |  |
| `data.cartonization_error` | string or null | no | Set when cartonization failed. |
| `data.contention_deferred` | number (double) | no | Quantity deferred because another transaction held the inventory lock. |
| `data.dispatched_tasks` | array of integer (int64) | no | Tasks THIS pass handed out — one per live pick of the order that had none yet (see the dispatch comment in `allocate_order_lines`). |
| `data.new_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.order_number` | string | yes |  |
| `data.picks` | array of integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.short` | number (double) | yes | Quantity that could not be reserved because the eligible stock did not exist (as opposed to being temporarily locked). |
| `data.status` | one of: New \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The header status AS DERIVED after the pass — `Allocated` / `PartiallyAllocated` before launch, `Released` / `PartiallyReleased` on a launched order (release's own nested pass runs after `released_at` is already written, so it reads the same ladder). |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "allocated": 1,
      "blocked_by_dropped_step": 1,
      "new_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1,
      "order_number": "<order_number>",
      "picks": [
        1
      ],
      "short": 1,
      "status": "New"
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "shipment_order_allocate",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_order_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### shipment_order_allocate_preview

Preview what allocation would do for this order.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / shipment_order_commands |
| Category | query (read operation; not declared in the catalog) |
| Operation | read (read_model) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `shipment_order_allocate_preview` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER |

**Notes**

- This method only reads. It changes nothing and needs no idempotency key.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | object (AllocationPreviewInput) | yes | Dry-run allocation: runs the exact plan `shipment_order_allocate` would, writes nothing. |

| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": AllocationPreview }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.advisory` | boolean | yes | Preview is observational and can be stale immediately after the read. |
| `data.allocated` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.blocked_by_dropped_step` | number (double) | yes | Sum of `lines[].blocked_by_dropped_step` — see that field's own doc. |
| `data.detail` | one of: summary \| full | yes | Cost level for planner explainability. |
| `data.lines` | array of object (LineAllocationPreview) | yes |  |
