| `data.lines[].allocation_policy_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | Frozen policy snapshot used by the shared planner. |
| `data.lines[].allocation_policy_version` | integer (int32) or null | no |  |
| `data.lines[].blocked_by_dropped_step` | number (double) | yes | This line's own `crate::allocation::LineAllocationPlan:: blocked_by_dropped_step` — a subset of `short` a caller can use to tell "the policy needs fixing" apart from "there is no stock." Zero on the common path. |
| `data.lines[].line_no` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.lines[].need` | number (double) | yes | `qty_to_allocate()` at read time, floored at zero. |
| `data.lines[].positions` | array of object (AllocatedPosition) | yes |  |
| `data.lines[].short` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.lines[].sku_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.lines[].steps` | array of object (StepDecision) | yes | Typed step-by-step explanation. |
| `data.lines[].uom` | string | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.order_number` | string | yes |  |
| `data.order_status` | one of: New \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | Carried through so a caller previewing an unlaunched order (see below) can tell the rungs apart without a second round trip. |
| `data.short` | number (double) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
            {

              "balance_id": null,
              "location": null,
              "lot": null,
              "qty": null,
              "uom": null
            }
          ],
          "short": 1,

            {
              "candidate_count": null,

              "remainder": null,
              "rule_num": null,
              "selected_qty": null,

              "step_id": null,

            }
          ],
          "uom": "<uom>"
        }
      ],

      "order_status": "New",
      "short": 1
    }
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |

**Example**

### shipment_order_cancel_allocation

Release every reservation on the order; the picks are deleted.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / shipment_order_commands |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `shipment_order_cancel_allocation` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `shipment_order`: send `expected_order_version` for row `order_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_order_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CancelOrderAllocation) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_order_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": CancelOrderAllocationResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.launch_cleared` | boolean | yes | True when the release pass cleared EVERY reservation and the launch marker (`released_at`) was reset — the order is back in its unlaunched life and a later Release launches it again. |
| `data.lines_affected` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.new_version` | integer (int32) | yes | The header version AFTER this command: bumped when the command wrote the header (a full clear resets `released_at` — a user write, so OCC moves), otherwise an echo of what was already there. |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.order_number` | string | yes |  |
| `data.released` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.skipped_in_work` | integer (int64) | yes | Picks left untouched because they are in work (MVP stub: a task holds them). |
| `data.status` | one of: New \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The header status AS DERIVED after the release pass — `New` when the launch marker was cleared (full un-reservation, owner decision 2026-08-24), `PartiallyReleased` when in-work picks kept the order launched (spec §2.2/§2.3). |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "launch_cleared": false,
      "lines_affected": 1,
      "new_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1,
      "order_number": "<order_number>",
      "released": 1,
      "skipped_in_work": 1,
      "status": "New"
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "shipment_order_cancel_allocation",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_order_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

Release a draft order (full validation, freezes the ship-to address).

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / shipment_order_commands |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `shipment_order_release` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `shipment_order`: send `expected_order_version` for row `order_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_order_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ReleaseShipmentOrder) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_order_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": ReleaseShipmentOrderResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.auto_allocation` | object (AllocateShipmentOrderResult) or null | no | What release's own allocation half did — `allocated`/`short` report the pass that ran in this same transaction. |
| `data.auto_allocation.allocated` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.auto_allocation.blocked_by_dropped_step` | number (double) | yes | Sum, across every line, of `crate::allocation::LineAllocationPlan::blocked_by_dropped_step` — base units `short` includes that were never searched for at all, because the only step of some line's policy naming that UOM rung failed to parse (round-2 review fin… |
| `data.auto_allocation.cartonization` | object (WrittenPlan) or null | no | What cartonization computed: the plan number and how many boxes, placements and unplaced items it holds. |
| `data.auto_allocation.cartonization_error` | string or null | no | Set when cartonization failed. |
| `data.auto_allocation.contention_deferred` | number (double) | no | Quantity deferred because another transaction held the inventory lock. |
| `data.auto_allocation.dispatched_tasks` | array of integer (int64) | no | Tasks THIS pass handed out — one per live pick of the order that had none yet (see the dispatch comment in `allocate_order_lines`). |
| `data.auto_allocation.new_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.auto_allocation.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.auto_allocation.order_number` | string | yes |  |
| `data.auto_allocation.picks` | array of integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.auto_allocation.short` | number (double) | yes | Quantity that could not be reserved because the eligible stock did not exist (as opposed to being temporarily locked). |
| `data.auto_allocation.status` | one of: New \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The header status AS DERIVED after the pass — `Allocated` / `PartiallyAllocated` before launch, `Released` / `PartiallyReleased` on a launched order (release's own nested pass runs after `released_at` is already written, so it reads the same ladder). |
| `data.auto_allocation_error` | string or null | no | `Some` when the allocation half failed (review round 1) — a misconfigured policy is the expected case, but any error `allocate_order_lines` returns lands here. |
| `data.new_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.order_number` | string | yes |  |
| `data.ship_to_snapshot` | any | yes |  |
| `data.status` | one of: New \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The header status AS DERIVED at the end of this command's own transaction — `Released` when the allocation half covered every live line, `PartiallyReleased` when it did not (spec §2.2). |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "new_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1,
      "order_number": "<order_number>",
      "ship_to_snapshot": {},
      "status": "New"
    }
  }
}
```

| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_order_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (UpdateShipmentOrder) | yes |  |
| `data.carrier_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.expected_order_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.external_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.notes` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.order_type_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.priority` | integer (int16) or null | no |  |
| `data.requested_ship_date` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.ship_to_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": UpdateShipmentOrderResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.new_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "new_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "shipment_order_update",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_order_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### pick_confirm_internal_lot

Confirm the Pick's reserved internal lot (scanned or typed) as a durable fact and renew the task lease.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_commands |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_confirm_internal_lot` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ConfirmPickInternalLot) | yes | The reserved internal lot, scanned from its label or typed (§11.2). |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.manual` | boolean | no | Typed on the keypad rather than scanned (R16). |
| `data.scanned_lot` | string | yes |  |
| `data.task_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": PickConfirmationResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.confirmed` | one of: Location \| Item \| SourceLpn \| Quantity \| InternalLot \| LotAttributes | yes |  |
| `data.episode_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.next` | object (RequiredEvidence) or null | no | What the plan still needs, in screen order; `None` once the source is proven. |
| `data.next.capture` | one of: Scan \| ScanOrManual | yes | How an operator may give one piece of evidence. |
| `data.next.code` | string or null | no | The lower-cased Lot Policy code of a `LotAttribute`; `None` otherwise. |
| `data.next.expected_display_value` | string or null | no | What the card shows the operator to compare with (a lot attribute's reserved value). |
| `data.next.kind` | one of: Location \| Item \| Lpn \| InternalLot \| LotAttribute | yes | What a plan can ask for. |
| `data.next.label` | string or null | no | The Lot Policy label of a `LotAttribute`. |
| `data.pick_detail_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.recorded` | array of object (EvidenceKey) | yes | The plan's evidence this call stored (empty on a re-scan the business key absorbed; the quantity is audit, not plan evidence, and is never listed). |
| `data.recorded[].code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.recorded[].kind` | one of: Location \| Item \| Lpn \| InternalLot \| LotAttribute | yes | What a plan can ask for. |
| `data.task_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.task_version` | integer (int32) | yes | The lease renewal bumps it; `pick_commit` / `pick_short` echo it. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "confirmed": "Location",
      "episode_id": 1,
      "pick_detail_id": 1,
      "recorded": [
        {
          "kind": "Location"
        }
      ],
      "task_id": 1,
      "task_version": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_confirm_internal_lot",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "scanned_lot": "<scanned_lot>",
      "task_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |


| `filters` | array of object | no | Filter criteria |
| `filters[].id` | integer filter | no | Filter on `id`. |
| `list_options` | object | no | Pagination/sorting |
| `list_options.limit` | integer | no |  |
| `list_options.offset` | integer | no |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": [OpenPickDropBoardRow] }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data[].destination_location` | string or null | no | The frozen destination; `None` while it holds nothing. |
| `data[].destination_takes_it` | boolean or null | no | That destination would take the closed pallet now (a type its policy revision allows, `Ok`, no flag, no hold against outbound); `None` while it has none. |
| `data[].drop_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].drop_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The pallet's CONTAINER id (the commit's `drop_id`). |
| `data[].has_goods` | boolean | yes | Stock anywhere in the pallet's tree. |
| `data[].id` | integer (int64) | yes | The pallet's record id — the row's selection identity, what a metadata list ticks and rereads the row by. |
| `data[].opened_at` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].operator_id` | integer (int64) | yes | Who holds it: the operator it is open for. |
| `data[].operator_name` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].operator_username` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].order_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].pick_drop_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The pallet's record — the retarget's `pick_drop_id`. |
| `data[].routed` | boolean | yes | The router froze a pack station as its destination. |
| `data[].version` | integer (int32) | yes | The record's version — the retarget's `expected_version`. |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 500 | SERVICE_ERROR | `list_options.limit` is above 5000 (the code maps this refusal to the general error). |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_drop_list",
  "params": {
    "filters": [
      {
        "id": 1
      }
    ],
    "list_options": {
      "limit": 10,
      "offset": 0
    }
  }
}'
```

### pick_drop_open

Open the operator's pick pallet (a scanned DRP label) for the task's order in INTRANSIT.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_commands |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_drop_open` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (OpenPickDrop) | yes | Wire command. |
| `data.drop_code` | string | yes | The scanned DRP label. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.task_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.work_area_code` | string or null | no | (The code comment for this item is not in English. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": OpenPickDropResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.already_open` | boolean | yes | The caller's open pallet of this order, scanned again: nothing was written. |
| `data.created` | boolean | yes | No container had the label: a new pallet was made. |
| `data.drop_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.drop_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The pallet's CONTAINER id — what a commit names as its `drop_id`. |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.released_drop_code` | string or null | no | The label of the caller's empty open pallet let go on the way. |
| `data.task_version` | integer (int32) | yes | The task after the lease renewal: the RF stores it for its next stateful confirmation. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "already_open": false,
      "created": false,
      "drop_code": "<drop_code>",
      "drop_id": 1,
      "order_id": 1,
      "task_version": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_drop_open",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "drop_code": "<drop_code>",
      "task_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### pick_manual_complete

Complete a reviewed workstation Pick: actual stock, Pick, Task and durable receipt atomically.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_commands |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_manual_complete` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `task`: send `expected_task_version` for row `task_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_task_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CompleteManualPick) | yes |  |
| `data.count_freeze_grant_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | A shift lead's single-use grant to take stock off a location an open Hard count is counting (owner's decision 2026-10-21 §6) — the same grant `CommitPick` redeems. |
| `data.destination_lpn` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.expected_task_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.instructions_acknowledged` | boolean | no |  |
| `data.serial_scans` | array of string | no |  |
| `data.source` | object (ManualPickSourceInput) | no |  |
| `data.source.internal_lot` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.source.internal_lot_typed` | boolean | no |  |
| `data.source.item_scan` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.source.location_scan` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.source.lot_attribute_scan` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.source.lot_attribute_scans` | array of string | no | Separate human scans, in addition to the legacy single-scan field. |
| `data.source.lot_attributes` | array of object (ManualLotAttribute) | no |  |
| `data.source.source_lpn_scan` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": CompleteManualPickResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.already_committed` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.ask_location_empty` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.completion_capability` | one of: Pack \| Consolidate \| Stage \| Ship \| None or null | no | Frozen before the physical write, not recomputed by later shipping. |
| `data.destination_balance_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.destination_container_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.destination_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.destination_lpn` | string | yes |  |
| `data.executed_by` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.line_status` | one of: NotAllocated \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The line's status ladder (migration 285, spec 2026-08-19 §1.2). |
| `data.movement_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `data.order_status` | one of: New \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The header's status ladder (migration 285, spec 2026-08-19 §1.1): `New → Allocated → Released → Picked → Closed`, every working rung with a `Partially` form, `Cancelled` reachable until things are picked. |
| `data.pick_detail_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.pick_status` | one of: Picked \| Allocated \| Released \| Cancelled \| Shorted \| AwaitingPlacement \| Returned | yes |  |
| `data.qty_picked` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.task_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.task_status` | one of: InProgress \| Completed \| Shorted \| Created \| Assigned \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.task_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_manual_complete",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_task_version": 1,
      "task_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### pick_reject

Reject untouched Pick work using Task Manager cooldown and refusal audit.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_commands |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_reject` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `task`: send `expected_task_version` for row `task_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_task_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (RejectPick) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_task_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.reason` | string | yes |  |
| `data.task_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.whole_group` | boolean | no | The summary step's reject (slice 5 §7): every remaining place of the group the task's pick stands in. |
| `data.work_area_code` | string or null | no | (The code comment for this item is not in English. |
| `data.work_area_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | Where the task cools down, and whose `allow_task_release` judges the return. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": RejectPickResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.rejected_task_ids` | array of integer (int64) | no | Every task that went back to the pool, ascending: the named one alone, or with `whole_group` every place taken along. |
| `data.reservation_unchanged` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.rest_exception_ids` | array of integer (int64) | no | The execution exceptions (`TargetLeftCart`) of the rests this reject repaired — rejected picks whose target could no longer be started as it stood (ruling D2), ascending. |
| `data.task` | object (Task) | yes | The named place's task, back in the pool. |
| `data.task.add_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.task.add_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.task.assignee` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.task.batch_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.task.claimed_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.task.container_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.task.created_at` | string | yes |  |
| `data.task.ended_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.escalated_at` | string or null | no | Set when the task went to a supervisor: refusals reached the threshold `TASK_SKIP_ESCALATE_AFTER`. |
| `data.task.from_location` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.heartbeat_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.task.lease_expires_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.lot` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.mod_when` | string | yes |  |
| `data.task.mod_who` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.task.owner_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.task.priority` | integer (int16) | yes |  |
| `data.task.qty` | number (double) or null | no |  |
| `data.task.qty_done` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.task.refused_count` | integer (int32) | yes | How many times the task was REFUSED (a hand-back does not count). |
| `data.task.return_kind` | string or null | no | HOW the task last went back to the pool: `Refused` (operator refused), `HandedBack` (operator handed it back), `Seized` (a supervisor took it), `Expired` (the lease ran out). |
| `data.task.short_reason_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.short_reason_note` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.skip_reason` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.skipped_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.sku_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.source_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.task.source_type` | string | yes |  |
| `data.task.started_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.status` | one of: InProgress \| Completed \| Shorted \| Created \| Assigned \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.task.task_type` | one of: Pick \| Putaway \| Replenish \| Move \| Count | yes |  |
| `data.task.to_location` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.uom` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.task.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.task.wave_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.task.weight` | number (double) or null | no | The stock weight of the task when it was created, using the one weight formula (`pack::StockWeights`), copied like `qty` (wms-app 340). |
| `data.task.workstation_completed_by` | integer (int64) or null | no | Real web executor of source-owned workstation Pick completion. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "reservation_unchanged": false,
      "task": {
        "add_when": "<add_when>",
        "add_who": 1,
        "code": "<code>",
        "created_at": "<created_at>",
        "id": 1,
        "mod_when": "<mod_when>",
        "mod_who": 1,
        "priority": 1,
        "qty_done": 1,
        "refused_count": 1,
        "source_id": 1,
        "source_type": "<source_type>",
        "status": "InProgress",
        "task_type": "Pick",
        "version": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_reject",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_task_version": 1,
      "reason": "<reason>",
      "task_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

| `data.verification.episode_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | The caller's usable open episode, if one exists. |
| `data.verification.next` | object (RequiredEvidence) or null | no | What the operator proves next; `None` when the plan is satisfied (or blocked). |
| `data.verification.plan` | object (VerificationPlan) or null | no | `None` exactly when `blocked` is set. |
| `data.verification.satisfied` | array of object (EvidenceKey) | yes | The plan's evidence already proven, in plan order. |
| `data.verification.stale` | boolean | yes | The caller's open episode proves another source, or belongs to another ownership (R8, R12): the plan restarts, and the first confirmation cancels that episode and opens a new one. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "data": {
      "allowed_actions": [
        "ConfirmLocation"
      ],
      "instructions": [
        "<instructions>"
      ],
      "instructions_require_acknowledgement": false,
      "order_id": 1,
      "pick_detail_id": 1,
      "serials_required": false,
      "source": {
        "location": "<location>",
        "lot": "<lot>",
        "lot_display": [
          {
            "code": "<code>",
            "label": "<label>",
            "value": "<value>",
            "verification": null
          }
        ],
        "lot_summary": "<lot_summary>",
        "owner_id": 1,
        "qty": 1,
        "sku_code": "<sku_code>",
        "uom": "<uom>"
      },
      "task_id": 1,
      "task_version": 1,
      "verification": {
        "satisfied": [
          {
            "kind": "Location"
          }
        ],
        "stale": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_work_get",
  "params": {
    "data": {
      "task_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### shared_pick_commit

Collect all or part of a station route stop into the route's shared tote.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_commands |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `shared_pick_commit` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `task`: send `expected_task_version` for row `task_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_task_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CommitSharedTotePick) | yes | Wire command: a station route stop's collection of `qty` (base units) into the scanned tote of the caller's route. |
| `data.count_freeze_grant_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | A shift lead's single-use grant to collect from a location an open Hard count is counting (owner's decision 2026-10-21 §6). |
| `data.expected_task_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.instructions_acknowledged` | boolean | no |  |
| `data.qty` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.task_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.tote_code` | string | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": CommitPickResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.already_committed` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.ask_location_empty` | boolean | no | The pick emptied its source location and the policy says to ask the operator whether it is empty (`pick_to_zero = Confirm`, count spec Appendix L): the RF asks, and sends the answer to `location_confirm_empty`. |
| `data.destination_balance_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.line_status` | one of: NotAllocated \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The line's status ladder (migration 285, spec 2026-08-19 §1.2). |
| `data.movement_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.order_status` | one of: New \| PartiallyAllocated \| Allocated \| PartiallyReleased \| Released \| PartiallyPicked \| Picked \| PartiallyShipped \| Shipped \| Closed \| Cancelled | yes | The header's status ladder (migration 285, spec 2026-08-19 §1.1): `New → Allocated → Released → Picked → Closed`, every working rung with a `Partially` form, `Cancelled` reachable until things are picked. |
| `data.pick_detail_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.pick_status` | one of: Picked \| Allocated \| Released \| Cancelled \| Shorted \| AwaitingPlacement \| Returned | yes | (The code comment for this item is not in English. |
| `data.qty_picked` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.route` | object (RouteProgress) or null | no | Present only for a pick of an assignment: where its route stands after this commit (R3). |
| `data.route.assignment_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.route.status` | one of: Picking \| Delivering \| Completed \| Dissolved \| Building \| Ready | yes |  |
| `data.route.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.task_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.task_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "already_committed": false,
      "line_status": "NotAllocated",
      "movement_id": 1,
      "order_status": "New",
      "pick_detail_id": 1,
      "pick_status": "Picked",
      "qty_picked": 1,
      "task_id": 1,
      "task_version": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "shared_pick_commit",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_task_version": 1,
      "qty": 1,
      "task_id": 1,
      "tote_code": "<tote_code>"
    }
  }
}'
```

|---|---|

| `list_options.offset` | integer | no |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data[].bound_at` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].holds_goods` | boolean | yes | Picks await placement in the tote: the door delivers it to the station; otherwise it releases the empty tote. |
| `data[].id` | integer (int64) | yes | The tote's ownership row — the board row's identity. |
| `data[].live_stops` | integer (int64) | yes | The route's stops still held under a live lease. |

| `data[].operator_username` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].route_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The door's `route_id`. |
| `data[].route_version` | integer (int32) | yes | The route's version — the door's `expected_version`. |
| `data[].state` | one of: Worked \| Abandoned | yes | What the button gate reads. |
| `data[].station_location` | string | yes | The frozen station the goods go to. |
| `data[].tote_code` | string | yes | The tote's label — the door's `tote_code`. |
| `data[].wave_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].work_area_code` | string | yes |  |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 500 | SERVICE_ERROR | `list_options.limit` is above 5000 (the code maps this refusal to the general error). |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "shared_pick_route_list",
  "params": {
    "filters": [
      {
        "id": 1
      }
    ],
    "list_options": {
      "limit": 10,
      "offset": 0
    }
  }
}'
```

| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CompleteSharedPickToteSupervised) | yes | Wire command: the route, its version as the board showed it, and the tote. |
| `data.expected_version` | integer (int32) | yes | `shared_pick_route.version` as the board showed it. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.route_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.tote_code` | string | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": SharedToteCompletedSupervised }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.route_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.route_version` | integer (int32) | yes | The route's version after the door — what the board echoes next. |
| `data.tote` | object | yes | What the supervisor's door did with the tote. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "route_id": 1,
      "route_version": 1,
      "tote": {
        "moved": false,
        "outcome": "delivered",
        "route_completed": false,
        "station_location": "<station_location>",
        "tote_container_id": 1,
        "wave_id": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "shared_pick_tote_complete_supervised",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "route_id": 1,
      "tote_code": "<tote_code>"
    }
  }
}'
```

### shared_pick_tote_deliver

Deliver a station route's shared tote to its frozen station.

## Module: pick_assignment

### cartonization_exception_list

List pick target execution exceptions (box full) for the supervisor, newest first.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_assignment |
| Category | query (read operation; not declared in the catalog) |
| Operation | read (read_model) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `cartonization_exception_list` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |

**Notes**

- This method only reads. It changes nothing and needs no idempotency key.
- In `filters`, a plain value means equals. An object such as `{"$gt": 5}` uses an operator. See 03-request-and-response-format.md.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filters` | array of object | no | Filter criteria |
| `filters[].id` | integer filter | no | Filter on `id`. |
| `filters[].target_kind` | string filter | no | Filter on `target_kind`. |
| `filters[].status` | string filter | no | Filter on `status`. |
| `filters[].order_number` | string filter | no | Filter on `order_number`. |
| `filters[].assignment_code` | string filter | no | Filter on `assignment_code`. |
| `filters[].box_code` | string filter | no | Filter on `box_code`. |
| `list_options` | object | no | Pagination/sorting |
| `list_options.limit` | integer | no |  |
| `list_options.offset` | integer | no |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": [TargetExceptionRow] }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data[].assignment_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].assignment_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].box_code` | string or null | no | The box reported full. |
| `data[].comment` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].continuation_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data[].error_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].error_detail` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].handed_over_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].kind` | string | yes | `pick_target_exception_kind` as text: `CartonFull` \\| `TargetLeftCart`. |
| `data[].order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].order_number` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].picks` | integer (int32) | yes | How many picks the exception replans. |
| `data[].position_no` | integer (int16) | yes |  |
| `data[].reason_code` | string or null | no | `carton_full_reason` as text — `CartonFull` only. |
| `data[].reported_at` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].reported_by` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].reported_by_name` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].resolved_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].resulting_plan_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data[].source_carton_code` | string or null | no | The full box's planned carton (`PlannedCarton` only). |
| `data[].status` | string | yes | `pick_target_exception_status` as text. |
| `data[].target_kind` | string | yes | `pick_target_kind` as text: `PlannedCarton` \\| `Bypassed`. |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 500 | SERVICE_ERROR | `list_options.limit` is above 5000 (the code maps this refusal to the general error). |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "cartonization_exception_list",
  "params": {
    "filters": [
      {
        "id": 1
      }
    ],
    "list_options": {
      "limit": 10,
      "offset": 0
    }
  }
}'
```

### cartonization_exception_retry

Retry the repair of a box-full exception that waits for recovery, as a supervisor.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_assignment |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `cartonization_exception_retry` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (RetryCartonException) | yes |  |
| `data.exception_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The exception, as the supervisor's list shows it. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": RetryCartonExceptionResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.already_finished` | boolean | yes | It was finished (`Resolved` or `Cancelled`) before this press: its result, nothing written. |
| `data.error_code` | string or null | no | `RecoveryRequired`: why the repair failed this time. |
| `data.exception_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.handed_over_picks` | array of integer (int64) | yes | Picks this retry took off a carrier first, ascending. |
| `data.new_cartons` | array of object (NewTargetOutcome) | yes | Resolved: the new planned cartons, each waiting whole for the next carrier (`position_no` empty). |
| `data.new_cartons[].carton_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.new_cartons[].carton_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | `PlannedCarton`: the new planned carton. |
| `data.new_cartons[].continuation_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | `Bypassed`: the continuation. |
| `data.new_cartons[].picks` | integer (int16) | yes | How many picks it carries. |
| `data.new_cartons[].position_no` | integer (int16) or null | no | The free place on this carrier; `None`: it waits for the next assignment. |
| `data.new_cartons[].target_kind` | one of: PlannedCarton \| Bypassed | yes |  |
| `data.released_task_ids` | array of integer (int64) | yes | Their tasks, `Seized` back to the pool, ascending. |
| `data.resulting_plan_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | Resolved: the child plan of the repair. |
| `data.status` | one of: Reported \| Resolving \| Resolved \| RecoveryRequired \| Cancelled | yes | `Resolved`, `RecoveryRequired` again, or `Cancelled` — nothing was left to repair. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "already_finished": false,
      "exception_id": 1,
      "handed_over_picks": [
        1
      ],
      "new_cartons": [
        {
          "picks": 1,
          "target_kind": "PlannedCarton"
        }
      ],
      "released_task_ids": [
        1
      ],
      "status": "Reported"
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "cartonization_exception_retry",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "exception_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### pick_assignment_bind_position

Bind a scanned box to a position of the operator's pick assignment carrier.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_assignment |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_assignment_bind_position` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (BindPickAssignmentPosition) | yes |  |
| `data.container_code` | string | yes | The scanned box — or, for a disposable carton, the planned carton's own label. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.position_no` | integer (int16) | yes | The position on the carrier (1..N), as `pick_assignment_get` named it. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": BindPickAssignmentPositionResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.already_bound` | boolean | yes | The position was already bound to this box: nothing was written. |
| `data.assignment` | object (PickAssignmentView) | yes | The assignment after the bind: its new `version`, `status` (`Ready` after the last bind) and the next step (the next `Open` position). |
| `data.assignment.allowed_actions` | array of one of: BindPosition \| Commit \| Skip \| Short \| Reject \| Complete \| Dissolve \| HandOver | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.assignment_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.carrier_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.assignment.carrier_container_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.assignment.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.positions_bound` | integer (int16) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.positions_total` | integer (int16) | yes | Positions that hold (or will hold) a box: `Open`, `Bound`, and a box closed full — it stays on the carrier until delivery. |
| `data.assignment.status` | one of: Picking \| Delivering \| Completed \| Dissolved \| Building \| Ready | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.step` | object | yes | The next step of an assignment. |
| `data.assignment.version` | integer (int32) | yes | Echo it back on `pick_assignment_dissolve` (a `stateful_command`). |
| `data.assignment.work_area_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.container_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.position_no` | integer (int16) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "already_bound": false,
      "assignment": {
        "allowed_actions": [
          "BindPosition"
        ],
        "assignment_id": 1,
        "code": "<code>",
        "positions_bound": 1,
        "positions_total": 1,
        "status": "Picking",
        "step": {
          "kind": "BindPosition",
          "order_id": 1,
          "order_number": "<order_number>",
          "planned_target_kind": null,
          "position_no": 1
        },
        "version": 1,
```

### pick_assignment_complete

Deliver your pick assignment's carrier (or a carrier dissolved with goods) to its delivery location and complete it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_assignment |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_assignment_complete` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CompletePickAssignment) | yes | "The carrier is delivered here" (spec C.3, C.6, ADR-091 section 4.4; R11 to R13). |
| `data.carrier_code` | string or null | no | A carrier dissolved with goods, scanned by any operator (R12). |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.location_code` | string or null | no | The scanned delivery location. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": CompletePickAssignmentResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.assignment_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.boxes_off` | array of integer (int64) | yes | Empty boxes taken off the carrier, ascending. |
| `data.boxes_unloaded` | array of integer (int64) | yes | Boxes with goods detached from the carrier: roots at the delivery location, stock untouched (R12/R21), ascending. |
| `data.carrier_freed` | boolean | yes | The carrier is `Empty` with no children — always `true` after a successful delivery (R12); kept as a field for the RF result. |
| `data.closed_positions` | array of integer (int16) | yes | Positions whose box holds goods: `Closed` (box and planned carton kept on the row as the record), ascending. |
| `data.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.delivered_by` | integer (int64) or null | no | Who delivered it: the caller — the holder, the operator who scanned a carrier dissolved with goods, or a supervisor on the holder's behalf (ruling D3). |
| `data.delivered_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.moved` | boolean | yes | The tree was moved (`false`: it already stood there, or `Complete`). |
| `data.released_positions` | array of integer (int16) | yes | Bound positions with an empty box: `Released`, the box off the carrier, ascending. |
| `data.status` | one of: Picking \| Delivering \| Completed \| Dissolved \| Building \| Ready | yes | `Completed`, or `Dissolved` for a carrier dissolved with goods. |
| `data.version` | integer (int32) | yes | The version after the delivery. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "assignment_id": 1,
      "boxes_off": [
        1
      ],
      "boxes_unloaded": [
        1
      ],
      "carrier_freed": false,
      "closed_positions": [
        1
      ],
      "code": "<code>",
      "delivered_location": "<delivered_location>",
      "moved": false,
      "released_positions": [
        1
      ],
      "status": "Picking",
      "version": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_assignment_complete",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {}
  }
}'
```

### pick_assignment_dissolve

Dissolve your own pick assignment; after its first commit with a supervisor's grant.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_assignment |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_assignment_dissolve` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `pick_assignment`: send `expected_version` for row `assignment_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (DissolvePickAssignment) | yes | The operator dissolves the assignment they hold (RF): before the first commit alone — after it, `DissolveRefusal::SupervisorConfirmationRequired` unless a supervisor's grant comes with it. |
| `data.assignment_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_version` | integer (int32) | yes | `pick_assignment.version` as `pick_assignment_get` returned it. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.override_grant_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | A supervisor's grant (`supervisor_override_grant`) for `pick_override_codes::dissolve_after_commit(assignment_id)` — lets the holder dissolve after a commit (R14). |

| `data.kept_positions` | array of integer (int16) | yes | `Bound` positions kept because their box holds goods, ascending. |
| `data.released_positions` | array of integer (int16) | yes | Positions `Released`, ascending. |
| `data.released_task_ids` | array of integer (int64) | yes | Tasks returned to the pool, ascending. |
| `data.rest_exception_ids` | array of integer (int64) | no | The execution exceptions (`TargetLeftCart`) of the rests this dissolve repaired — targets whose rest could no longer be started as it stood (ruling D2), ascending. |
| `data.status` | one of: Picking \| Delivering \| Completed \| Dissolved \| Building \| Ready | yes |  |
| `data.version` | integer (int32) | yes | The version after the dissolve. |

```json
      ],

      ],

      ],
```

|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_assignment_dissolve_supervised",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "assignment_id": 1,
      "reason": "<reason>"
    }
  }
}'
```

|---|---|

| `filters[].code` | string filter | no | Filter on `code`. |
| `filters[].status` | string filter | no | Filter on `status`. |

| `filters[].carrier_code` | string filter | no | Filter on `carrier_code`. |
| `list_options` | object | no | Pagination/sorting |

| `list_options.offset` | integer | no |  |

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data[].assignee` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].assignee_name` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].assignee_username` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].awaits_delivery` | boolean | yes | The cart waits to be delivered: `Delivering`, or dissolved with a box still on its carrier and never delivered — what the supervisor's delivery and retarget act on (ruling R6). |
| `data[].carrier_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].carrier_container_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data[].code` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].completed_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].created_at` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].delivery_location` | string or null | no | Where the cart goes — frozen at start, moved only by a retarget; `None` for a cart that never froze one. |
| `data[].dissolved_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].grouping_unit` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].positions_bound` | integer (int32) | yes | Positions holding a box now (Bound) or to the end (Closed). |
| `data[].positions_total` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data[].ready_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].status` | string | yes | `pick_assignment_status` as text. |
| `data[].version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data[].work_area_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].work_area_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |

| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

    }
  }
```
