### pick_assignment_position_close

Report the box at a position of your pick assignment full: it closes, the rest goes into new cartons.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_assignment |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_assignment_position_close` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ClosePickAssignmentPosition) | yes |  |
| `data.comment` | string or null | no | Required when `reason_code` is `OTHER`. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.position_no` | integer (int16) | yes | The position whose box is full, as `pick_assignment_get` named it. |
| `data.reason` | one of: CartonFull | yes | Why a position is closed on the route. |
| `data.reason_code` | one of: MASTER_DATA_DIMENSIONS \| PROTECTIVE_PACKAGING \| ORIENTATION_NOT_FEASIBLE \| PRODUCT_OR_CARTON_DEFORMED \| SOLVER_LAYOUT_NOT_FEASIBLE \| OTHER | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": ClosePickAssignmentPositionResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.already_reported` | boolean | yes | The position was already closed full: nothing was written, the existing exception is answered (T9). |
| `data.assignment` | object (PickAssignmentView) | yes | The assignment after the close: its version, status and next step. |
| `data.assignment.allowed_actions` | array of one of: BindPosition \| Commit \| Skip \| Short \| Reject \| Complete \| Dissolve \| HandOver | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.assignment_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.carrier_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.assignment.carrier_container_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.assignment.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.positions_bound` | integer (int16) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.positions_total` | integer (int16) | yes | Positions that hold (or will hold) a box: `Open`, `Bound`, and a box closed full — it stays on the carrier until delivery. |
| `data.assignment.status` | one of: Picking \| Delivering \| Completed \| Dissolved \| Building \| Ready | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.step` | object | yes | The next step of an assignment. |
| `data.assignment.version` | integer (int32) | yes | Echo it back on `pick_assignment_dissolve` (a `stateful_command`). |
| `data.assignment.work_area_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.box_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.error_code` | string or null | no | `RecoveryRequired`: why the repair failed. |
| `data.exception_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.exception_status` | one of: Reported \| Resolving \| Resolved \| RecoveryRequired \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.left_picks` | array of integer (int64) | yes | Picks that left the assignment for the next one, ascending. |
| `data.new_targets` | array of object (NewTargetOutcome) | yes |  |
| `data.new_targets[].carton_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.new_targets[].carton_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | `PlannedCarton`: the new planned carton. |
| `data.new_targets[].continuation_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | `Bypassed`: the continuation. |
| `data.new_targets[].picks` | integer (int16) | yes | How many picks it carries. |
| `data.new_targets[].position_no` | integer (int16) or null | no | The free place on this carrier; `None`: it waits for the next assignment. |
| `data.new_targets[].target_kind` | one of: PlannedCarton \| Bypassed | yes |  |
| `data.next_action` | one of: BindNewBox \| ContinueRoute \| Deliver \| HandOverToRecovery | yes | What the operator does next. |
| `data.position_no` | integer (int16) | yes |  |
| `data.released_task_ids` | array of integer (int64) | yes | Tasks handed back to the pool, ascending. |
| `data.remaining_picks` | integer (int16) | yes | Picks still open on this carrier's route after the close. |
| `data.resulting_plan_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | `PlannedCarton`, resolved: the child plan of the repair. |
| `data.target_kind` | one of: PlannedCarton \| Bypassed | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "already_reported": false,
      "assignment": {
        "allowed_actions": [
          "BindPosition"
        ],
        "assignment_id": 1,
        "code": "<code>",
        "positions_bound": 1,
        "positions_total": 1,
        "status": "Picking",
        "step": {
          "kind": "BindPosition",
          "order_id": 1,
          "order_number": "<order_number>",
          "planned_target_kind": null,
          "position_no": 1
        },
        "version": 1,
        "work_area_id": 1
      },
      "box_code": "<box_code>",
      "exception_id": 1,
      "exception_status": "Reported",
      "left_picks": [
        1
      ],
      "new_targets": [
        {
          "picks": 1,
          "target_kind": "PlannedCarton"
        }
      ],
      "next_action": "BindNewBox",
      "position_no": 1,
      "released_task_ids": [
        1
      ],
      "remaining_picks": 1,
      "target_kind": "PlannedCarton"
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_assignment_position_close",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "position_no": 1,
      "reason": "CartonFull",
      "reason_code": "MASTER_DATA_DIMENSIONS"
    }
  }
}'
```

**Example**


### pick_assignment_position_replace_container

Replace the damaged box at a position of your pick assignment by a new box: the goods move into it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_assignment |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_assignment_position_replace_container` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ReplacePickAssignmentContainer) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.new_container_code` | string | yes | The scanned new box (or, for a position planned as a disposable carton, that carton's own label). |
| `data.position_no` | integer (int16) | yes | The position whose box is damaged, as `pick_assignment_get` named it. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": ReplacePickAssignmentContainerResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.already_replaced` | boolean | yes | The position was already bound to this box by a replacement: nothing was written, the recorded replacement is answered. |
| `data.assignment` | object (PickAssignmentView) | yes | The assignment after the replacement: its version and next step. |
| `data.assignment.allowed_actions` | array of one of: BindPosition \| Commit \| Skip \| Short \| Reject \| Complete \| Dissolve \| HandOver | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.assignment_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.carrier_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.assignment.carrier_container_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.assignment.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.positions_bound` | integer (int16) | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.positions_total` | integer (int16) | yes | Positions that hold (or will hold) a box: `Open`, `Bound`, and a box closed full — it stays on the carrier until delivery. |
| `data.assignment.status` | one of: Picking \| Delivering \| Completed \| Dissolved \| Building \| Ready | yes |  |
| `data.assignment.step` | object | yes | The next step of an assignment. |
| `data.assignment.version` | integer (int32) | yes | Echo it back on `pick_assignment_dissolve` (a `stateful_command`). |
| `data.assignment.work_area_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.balances_moved` | integer (uint64) | yes | Balance rows with stock that moved into the new box (0 on `already_replaced`: nothing moved this time). |
| `data.damage_hold_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.new_container_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.old_container_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.old_container_outcome` | one of: Disposed \| HeldDamaged | yes | `Disposed`: a disposable box, written off. |
| `data.position_no` | integer (int16) | yes |  |
| `data.replacement_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "already_replaced": false,
      "assignment": {
        "allowed_actions": [
          "BindPosition"
        ],
        "assignment_id": 1,
        "code": "<code>",
        "positions_bound": 1,
        "positions_total": 1,
        "status": "Picking",
        "step": {
          "kind": "BindPosition",
          "order_id": 1,
          "order_number": "<order_number>",
          "planned_target_kind": null,
          "position_no": 1
        },
        "version": 1,
        "work_area_id": 1
      },
      "balances_moved": 1,
      "new_container_code": "<new_container_code>",
      "old_container_code": "<old_container_code>",
      "old_container_outcome": "Disposed",
      "position_no": 1,
      "replacement_id": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_assignment_position_replace_container",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "new_container_code": "<new_container_code>",
      "position_no": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### pick_destination_retarget

Send the goods of a cart waiting for delivery or of a loaded pick pallet to another location when the frozen one no longer takes them, as a supervisor.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / pick_assignment |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `pick_destination_retarget` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `pick_assignment`: send `expected_version` for row `assignment_id` |
| Version check | entity `pick_drop`: send `expected_version` for row `pick_drop_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_version`, `expected_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (RetargetPickDestination) | yes | Wire command. |
| `data.assignment_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | A cart waiting for delivery (`pick_assignment.id`): `Delivering`, or dissolved with goods on its carrier. |
| `data.expected_version` | integer (int32) | yes | The subject's version as the board showed it. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.location_code` | string | yes | The new destination. |
| `data.pick_drop_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | A loaded open pick pallet's RECORD (`pick_drop.id`, the wire's `pick_drop_id` — not its container). |
| `data.reason` | string | no | Why — written on the journal row. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": RetargetPickDestinationResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.assignment_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.from_location` | string or null | no | The destination it replaced — for a cart finished in place, the location its carrier stood in (`None`: it had none). |
| `data.order_ids` | array of integer (int64) | no | The orders whose later pallets and carts now go to `to_location`, ascending. |
| `data.pick_drop_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.retarget_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The journal row. |
| `data.routed` | boolean | yes | The router still waits there (`completion_capability` kept). |
| `data.to_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.version` | integer (int32) | yes | The subject's version after the change. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "retarget_id": 1,
      "routed": false,
      "to_location": "<to_location>",
      "version": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_destination_retarget",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "location_code": "<location_code>"
    }
  }
}'
```

| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "pick_short_reason_update_draft",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "actions": [
        {
          "action": "ReleaseCurrentRemainder"
        }
      ],
      "allow_partial": false,
      "allow_zero": false,
      "description": "<description>",
      "reason_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

Retire a published picking-policy revision no work area depends on.

| Context / module | outbound / picking_policy |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data.policy_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": PickingPolicyView }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| `data.resolved.pick_to_zero` | one of: Off \| Count \| Confirm | yes | What a full pick that leaves its source location holding no stock does (wms-app 111, count spec Appendices D and L). |
| `data.resolved.published_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.resolved.qty_confirmation` | one of: PerPick \| Aggregated | yes |  |
| `data.resolved.reserved_lpn_confirmation` | one of: DoNotConfirm \| ScanWhenPresent | yes |  |
| `data.resolved.retired_at` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.resolved.revision_no` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.resolved.source_location_confirmation` | one of: DisplayOnly \| Scan | yes |  |
| `data.resolved.status` | one of: Draft \| Published \| Retired | yes |  |
| `data.resolved.target_binding` | one of: Unbound \| BeforeRoute | yes |  |
| `data.resolved.target_confirmation` | one of: ScanContainer \| PositionNumber | yes |  |
| `data.resolved.version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.work_area_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

```json
        ],
        "pick_to_zero": "Off",
        "qty_confirmation": "PerPick",
        "reserved_lpn_confirmation": "DoNotConfirm",
        "revision_no": 1,

        "status": "Draft",
        "target_binding": "Unbound",
        "target_confirmation": "ScanContainer",
        "version": 1
      },
      "work_area_id": 1
    }

}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |

### work_area_equipment_policy_list

List work areas' picking policies by equipment profile (filter by work_area_id).

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / picking_policy |

| Operation | read (read_model) |

| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR, VIEWER |

**Notes**

| `filters[].equipment_profile_id` | integer filter | no | Filter on `equipment_profile_id`. |
| `filters[].equipment_profile_code` | string filter | no | Filter on `equipment_profile_code`. |
| `filters[].picking_policy_code` | string filter | no | Filter on `picking_policy_code`. |
| `list_options` | object | no | Pagination/sorting |
| `list_options.limit` | integer | no |  |
| `list_options.offset` | integer | no |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": [WorkAreaPickingPolicyRow] }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data[].equipment_profile_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].equipment_profile_description` | string or null | no |  |
| `data[].equipment_profile_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].picking_policy_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].work_area_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 500 | SERVICE_ERROR | `list_options.limit` is above 5000 (the code maps this refusal to the general error). |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "work_area_equipment_policy_list",
  "params": {
    "filters": [
      {
        "id": 1
      }
    ],
    "list_options": {
      "limit": 10,
      "offset": 0
    }
  }
}'
```

## Module: packing

### packing_add

Move picked goods from the pallet being repacked into an open output carton.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / packing |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `packing_add` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |

| `data.tran_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The journal row. |

### packing_carton_close

Close a package or an output carton with its measured weight; prints its shipping label.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / packing |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `packing_carton_close` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `packing_carton`: send `expected_version` for row `carton_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ClosePackingCarton) | yes |  |
| `data.carton_full` | boolean | no | An output carton closed because it is physically full (§19). |
| `data.carton_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_version` | integer (int32) | yes | `packing_carton.version` as the operator saw it. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.measured_gross_weight` | number (double) or null | no | The scale's reading, in the owner's canonical weight UOM. |
| `data.printer_code` | string or null | no | The printer the operator scanned for the shipping label (an active printer's code); absent — the station's printer. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": ClosePackingCartonResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.carton_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.carton_version` | integer (int32) | yes | The version after the close. |
| `data.execution_expected_weight` | number (double) or null | no |  |
| `data.job_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.job_status` | one of: Open \| Packed \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.label_printer` | object (LabelPrinter) or null | no | Where the shipping label is printed after the commit; `None` — no printer covers the station, no label. |
| `data.label_printer.code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.label_printer.id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.label_printer.name` | string | yes |  |
| `data.measured_gross_weight` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.obligation_status` | one of: Open \| Satisfied or null | no | A package's obligation after the close; `None` for an output carton of `Repack` (its source's obligation is not touched, §11.4). |
| `data.order_packed` | boolean | yes | The close finished the order's packing (spec §14). |
| `data.unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The package's unit, or the unit the output carton released. |
| `data.unit_next` | one of: Pack \| Consolidate \| Stage \| Ship \| None | yes | What the router sends the package to next (`None`: its flow is done). |
| `data.unit_status` | one of: Pending \| Completed \| Consumed | yes |  |
| `data.weight_verdict` | one of: Recorded \| NotComparable | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "carton_id": 1,
      "carton_version": 1,
      "job_id": 1,
      "job_status": "Open",
      "measured_gross_weight": 1,
      "order_packed": false,
      "unit_id": 1,
      "unit_next": "Pack",
      "unit_status": "Pending",
      "weight_verdict": "Recorded"
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "packing_carton_close",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "carton_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### packing_carton_reopen

Reopen a closed package with a supervisor's grant and a reason.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / packing |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `packing_carton_reopen` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `packing_carton`: send `expected_version` for row `carton_id` |

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |

| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |

| `data.carton_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_version` | integer (int32) | yes | `packing_carton.version` as the operator saw it. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.override_grant_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | A supervisor's grant for `packing_override_codes::reopen_carton(carton_id)`. |
| `data.reason` | string | yes | Why the package is reopened; journalled. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": ReopenPackingCartonResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |

| `data.carton_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

| `data.obligation_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | A package's obligation; `None` for an output carton of `Repack`. |
| `data.obligation_status` | one of: Open \| Satisfied or null | no |  |
| `data.reopen_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The journal row. |
| `data.unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.unit_next` | one of: Pack \| Consolidate \| Stage \| Ship \| None | yes | What the unit waits for now: `Pack` again. |
| `data.unit_status` | one of: Pending \| Completed \| Consumed | yes |  |

```json
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },

      "authorized_by": 1,
      "carton_id": 1,
      "carton_status": "Open",
      "carton_version": 1,
      "job_id": 1,
      "job_reopened": false,
      "job_status": "Open",
      "reopen_id": 1,
      "unit_id": 1,
      "unit_next": "Pack",
      "unit_status": "Pending"
    }
  }
}
```

| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |

| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |

### packing_exception_resolve

Resolve an open packing exception after investigation; the order packs if nothing else holds it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / packing |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `packing_exception_resolve` |

| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `packing_exception`: send `expected_version` for row `exception_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ResolvePackingException) | yes |  |
| `data.exception_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_version` | integer (int32) | yes | `packing_exception.version` as the supervisor saw it. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.note` | string or null | no | What the supervisor writes about it; blank is none. |
| `data.resolution` | one of: NoDiscrepancy \| CorrectedByAccounting \| WrittenOffToLost \| SetAsideForCount | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": ResolvePackingExceptionResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.exception_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.job_status` | one of: Open \| Packed \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.order_packed` | boolean | yes | The resolution was the last thing that held the order (spec §14). |
| `data.resolution` | one of: NoDiscrepancy \| CorrectedByAccounting \| WrittenOffToLost \| SetAsideForCount | yes |  |
| `data.status` | one of: Open \| Resolved | yes |  |
| `data.version` | integer (int32) | yes | The version after the resolution. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "exception_id": 1,
      "job_status": "Open",
      "order_id": 1,
      "order_packed": false,
      "resolution": "NoDiscrepancy",
      "status": "Open",
      "version": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
```

### packing_source_complete

Complete a repacked pallet: its obligation is satisfied and its router unit consumed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / packing |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `packing_source_complete` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `packing_obligation`: send `expected_version` for row `obligation_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CompletePackingSource) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_version` | integer (int32) | yes | `packing_obligation.version` as the operator saw it. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.obligation_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The obligation over the pallet repacked, as `packing_work_open` answered it. |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": CompletePackingSourceResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.job_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.job_status` | one of: Open \| Packed \| Cancelled | yes |  |
| `data.obligation_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.obligation_status` | one of: Open \| Satisfied | yes |  |
| `data.obligation_version` | integer (int32) | yes | The version after the completion. |
| `data.order_packed` | boolean | yes | The completion finished the order's packing (spec §14). |
| `data.unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.unit_status` | one of: Pending \| Completed \| Consumed | yes | `Consumed`. |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "job_id": 1,
      "job_status": "Open",
      "obligation_id": 1,
      "obligation_status": "Open",
      "obligation_version": 1,
      "order_packed": false,
      "unit_id": 1,
      "unit_status": "Pending"
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "packing_source_complete",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "obligation_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |

| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CloseStationBox) | yes |  |
| `data.box_code` | string | yes | The scanned box's code. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.station_location` | string | yes | The station's location code (type `Sort`). |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": StationBoxClosed }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.box_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.destination` | string or null | no | Where the box goes next (the pack station), when it was handed over. |

| `data.picks` | integer (uint) | yes | The picks that left in the box (0: an empty box stayed on the freed position). |

| `data.position_no` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.station_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.unit_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | The router unit the box became, when its area names a next step. |

```json
      "order_id": 1,
      "picks": 1,
      "position_freed": false,
      "position_no": 1,
      "station_location": "<station_location>"
    }
  }
}
```

| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |

```bash

}'
```

| `list_options.offset` | integer | no |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `data[].free` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].station_location` | string | yes |  |

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|

| 500 | SERVICE_ERROR | `list_options.limit` is above 5000 (the code maps this refusal to the general error). |

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \

  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

      "offset": 0
    }
  }
}'
```

### station_order_withdraw

Withdraw an unshipped station order and free its tote remainder for return.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / station |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `station_order_withdraw` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `shipment_order`: send `expected_order_version` for row `order_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_order_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (WithdrawStationOrder) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_order_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.reason` | string | yes |  |
| `data.station_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.tote_code` | string | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": StationOrderWithdrawn }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.new_order_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.position_freed` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data.ready_to_return_qty` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.returned_pick_ids` | array of integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.station_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.tote_code` | string | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "new_order_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1,
      "position_freed": false,
      "ready_to_return_qty": 1,
      "returned_pick_ids": [
        1
      ],
      "station_location": "<station_location>",
      "tote_code": "<tote_code>"
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "station_order_withdraw",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "expected_order_version": 1,
      "order_id": 1,
      "reason": "<reason>",
      "station_location": "<station_location>",
      "tote_code": "<tote_code>"
    }
  }
}'
```

### station_tote_lost

Declare a whole tote lost before reaching the station (supervisor).

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / station |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `station_tote_lost` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ShortStationTote) | yes |  |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.owner_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | Omitted: the physical declaration covers this code for every owner. |
| `data.reason_code` | string | no |  |
| `data.sku_code` | string or null | no | No quantity: every remaining pick of this item, across all lots. |
| `data.station_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.tote_code` | string | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": StationToteShorted }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.lost_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.picks` | array of object (StationShortedPick) | yes |  |
| `data.picks[].pick_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.picks[].qty` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.picks[].remediation_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.picks[].shorted_pick_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.qty` | number (double) | yes |  |
| `data.station_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data.tote_code` | string | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "lost_location": "<lost_location>",
      "picks": [
        {
          "pick_id": 1,
          "qty": 1,
          "remediation_id": 1,
          "shorted_pick_id": 1
        }
      ],
      "qty": 1,
      "station_location": "<station_location>",
      "tote_code": "<tote_code>"
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "station_tote_lost",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "station_location": "<station_location>",
      "tote_code": "<tote_code>"
    }
  }
}'
```

### consolidation_remove

Take a box off an open consolidation pallet.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / consolidation |
| Category | stateless_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `consolidation_remove` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- There is no version check.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (ConsolidationRemove) | yes |  |
| `data.container_code` | string | yes | The box's label, as scanned. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.session_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": ConsolidationRemoveResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.boxes` | integer (int64) | yes | Boxes left on the pallet. |
| `data.container_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.pallet_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.target_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.target_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "boxes": 1,
      "container_code": "<container_code>",
      "pallet_code": "<pallet_code>",
      "target_id": 1,
      "target_version": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "consolidation_remove",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "container_code": "<container_code>",
      "session_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

|---|---|---|---|
| `data[].boxes_waiting` | integer (int64) | yes | Boxes waiting at the station that stand on no pallet yet. |
| `data[].closed_pallets` | integer (int64) | yes | Closed pallets whose container still stands at the station. |
| `data[].open_pallets` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data[].station_location` | string | yes |  |
| `data[].work_areas` | string or null | no | The work areas whose consolidation station this is, comma-separated; `None` when no area names it (no box is sent there). |

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 500 | SERVICE_ERROR | `list_options.limit` is above 5000 (the code maps this refusal to the general error). |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "consolidation_station_list",
  "params": {
    "filters": [
      {
        "station_location": "<station_location>"
      }
    ],
    "list_options": {
      "limit": 10,
      "offset": 0
    }
  }
}'
```

### consolidation_target_close

Close a consolidation pallet: it becomes an outbound unit of its own.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / consolidation |
| Category | stateful_command |
| Operation | execute (domain_command) |
| Permission | RBAC resource type `api`, resource code `consolidation_target_close` |
| Roles that have it by default | ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, OPERATOR |
| Idempotency key | required |
| Version check | entity `consolidation_target`: send `expected_version` for row `target_id` |

**Notes**

- Send `meta.idempotency_key`. If you send the same call again with the same key and the same data, you get the first answer back and nothing runs twice.
- Send the current version of the row in `expected_version`. If the row changed in between, the call fails with return code 40 and tells you the current state.

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | object | no | Control-plane envelope (idempotency_key, expected_version, acknowledged_overrides — bare integer codes for receipt, or {code, subject} override pairs for move). |
| `meta.acknowledged_overrides` | array of integer or object | no |  |
| `meta.expected_version` | integer (int64) | no |  |
| `meta.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | no |  |
| `data` | object (CloseConsolidationTarget) | yes |  |
| `data.expected_version` | integer (int32) | yes | `consolidation_target.version` as the operator saw it. |
| `data.idempotency_key` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `data.target_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |

**Result**

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "meta": { "idempotency_replayed": boolean }, "data": CloseConsolidationTargetResult }`

`meta.idempotency_replayed` is `true` when the answer is a stored copy of an earlier call with the same key.

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.boxes` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.pallet_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.pallet_unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The pallet's router unit, `Completed`: what Stage takes. |
| `data.pallet_unit_status` | one of: Pending \| Completed \| Consumed | yes |  |
| `data.target_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.target_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_replayed": false
    },
    "data": {
      "boxes": 1,
      "pallet_code": "<pallet_code>",
      "pallet_unit_id": 1,
      "pallet_unit_status": "Pending",
      "target_id": 1,
      "target_version": 1
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 42 | The idempotency key was used before with different data. Make a new key. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 44 | The first call with this key is still running. Send the same call again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR, return_code 40 | The row changed since you read it. The answer carries `context.current_state`. Read again and decide again. |
| 400 | RF_ERROR (other return codes) | A business rule refused the command. Read `detail.message`, `detail.return_code` and `detail.class`. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "consolidation_target_close",
  "params": {
    "meta": {
      "idempotency_key": "7f1c2d4e-5a6b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
    },
    "data": {
      "target_id": 1
    }
  }
}'
```

### consolidation_target_get

Read a consolidation pallet and the boxes on it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Context / module | outbound / consolidation |
| Category | query (read operation; not declared in the catalog) |

**Parameters** (the keys of `params`)

The `result` member of the response is: `{ "data": ConsolidationTargetView }`

| Field | Type | Always present | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data.boxes` | array of object (ConsolidationBox) | yes |  |
| `data.boxes[].container_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.boxes[].container_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.boxes[].dispatch_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | The route the box goes on (its assignment); `None` without one. |
| `data.boxes[].order_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.boxes[].order_number` | string | yes |  |
| `data.boxes[].owner_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The owner of the box's container. |
| `data.boxes[].pallet_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `data.boxes[].station_location` | string or null | no | The consolidation station the box waits at (its unit's destination). |
| `data.boxes[].stop_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.boxes[].target_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | The pallet the box stands on, when it is a target's. |
| `data.boxes[].unit_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.boxes[].unit_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |
| `data.pallet` | object (ConsolidationPallet) | yes | An open pallet of a station, with how many boxes stand on it. |

| `data.pallet.dispatch_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.pallet.order_id` | integer (int64) or null | no | The one order of a pallet with no route; `None` for a routed one. |
| `data.pallet.order_number` | string | yes | The orders of the boxes on the pallet, comma-separated (H2: a routed pallet may carry several). |
| `data.pallet.owner_id` | integer (int64) | yes | The owner every box on the pallet belongs to. |
| `data.pallet.pallet_code` | string | yes |  |
| `data.pallet.status` | one of: Open \| Closed | yes |  |
| `data.pallet.stop_id` | integer (int64) or null | no |  |
| `data.pallet.target_id` | integer (int64) | yes |  |
| `data.pallet.target_version` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

Example response. It shows the shape only. The required fields have placeholder values:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "data": {
      "boxes": [
        {
          "container_code": "<container_code>",
          "container_id": 1,
          "order_id": 1,
          "order_number": "<order_number>",
          "owner_id": 1,
          "unit_id": 1,
          "unit_version": 1
        }
      ],
      "pallet": {
        "boxes": 1,
        "order_number": "<order_number>",
        "owner_id": 1,
        "pallet_code": "<pallet_code>",
        "status": "Open",
        "target_id": 1,
        "target_version": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors**

| HTTP | Error | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | RPC_PARAMS_INVALID | A parameter is missing or has the wrong type. |
| 401 | NO_AUTH | No valid cookie, API key or service token. |
| 403 | RBAC_FORBIDDEN / RBAC_NO_ROLE | Your role may not call this method, or you have no role in the warehouse. |
| 400 / 403 | WAREHOUSE_REQUIRED, WAREHOUSE_NOT_AVAILABLE, WAREHOUSE_SELECTOR_INVALID | The `X-Warehouse-Id` header is missing, wrong or not yours. |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/rpc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WMS_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Warehouse-Id: $WAREHOUSE_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "consolidation_target_get",

  }
```
